3 عَارَكَهُ , (TA,) inf. n. مُعَارَكَةٌ (S, O, K, TA) and عِرَاكٌ, (TA,) He fought him; contended with him in fight, or battle: (S, * O, * K, * TA:) مُعَارَكَةٌ signifies the act of fighting; and thrusting at and wounding, one another, in fight, or battle. (KL.) ―
-b2- And عِرَاكٌ signifies also, in relation to camels, The pressing, or crowding, one another, at, or to get to, the water. (TA.) [See also this word below. And see 8.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
